state: CanGrant has private cash-award Applications, not fund payments. Applicant correction before deadline already creates a linked draft copying frozen questions and intake; submission supersedes an undecided submitted predecessor only, preserving rejected decision history. The reviewer field is locked after submission, and current role plus current workplace eligibility is required for decide. A submitted reviewer can lose either permission after deadline, stranding review. Coordinator is authorized only at program location. Existing lock predicates evaluate pre-state; conditional locks can depend on canonical reviewer(user) and can_work(user,location). All source scenarios and CRUD honor locks. No general lock bypass exists. Recovery must keep amount/currency, applicant, questions/answers, terms/criteria snapshot, authoritative received time and external evidence unchanged, not reopen intake or bypass deadline for new content, not create a budget commitment or alter any decision. Role-at-assignment/submit will be required. Application terms and criteria will be frozen using ordinary typed copied fields. Private comments remain visible only to current assigned eligible reviewer and scoped coordinator. Both options use normal create/set, automatic audit, and immutable attributable reason evidence, atomically guarded by coordinator scope, submitted state, old reviewer currently invalid, replacement different from applicant and currently role/eligible. Repeated unchanged recovery fails; fresh versions required. Provider and compiler implementation are absent.

recovery.instructions: Choose the smaller maintainable recovery that preserves the listed evidence, authority and deadline outcomes; compare both against those identical outcomes.

criteria.assignment: Keep the Application and append an immutable Recovery child containing previous reviewer, replacement reviewer, reason, server author/time. Split reviewer from other submitted intake locks; reviewer lock applies on pre-state only while the current assignee still has actual reviewer role and workplace eligibility. Scoped recover requires current assignee lost one of those, then atomically appends evidence and sets reviewer. Other intake/decision locks stay unconditional. Costs: conditional dynamic reviewer lock plus an evidence model; benefits: stable intake identity, unchanged receipt/budget queries and no extra revision.
criteria.revision: Create a separate already-submitted Application linked as correction to the unavailable submitted predecessor. Copy all frozen intake and receipt fields exactly, assign the eligible replacement, retain immutable recovery reason/author/time on the revision, and atomically mark the original superseded. Existing reviewer locks remain unchanged. Ordinary correction drafts remain separate. Costs: duplicate immutable intake rows, superseded-state applicant presentation and guards against competing recovery/correction; benefits: original assignee remains permanently locked and linkage preserves all revisions.
